QuestInfo.name: Re-Puppeteering
QuestInfo.0: As a descendant of the Cygnus Knights, you must carry out a simple mission. Talk to Neinheart to find out more.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Sleepy Dungeon and find the traces of the Puppeteer.\nIf you happen to see the Puppeteer at his hideout, you must battle him.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Puppeteer at the Puppeteer's Hiding Place.

0.0: There you are! My intel suggests that the Puppeteer has returned and you will be looking into it.

yes.0: One of my scouts spotted the Puppeteer near the Drake Cave in Sleepy Dungeon. Investigate until you can locate the Puppeteer's Hiding Place.

no.0: I apologize, I thought you were one of the Cygnus Knights, but apparently you are a chicken in gaudy armor.

yes.0: The Puppeteer will think twice about hounding us.

mob.0: The Puppeteer was seen in the #m105020200# area of the Sleepy Dungeon. Find him and put a stop to his nonsense.
